summary: Google Cloud's AI startup program grants up to $350,000 in Google Cloud credits over two years for eligible AI-first, VC-funded startups (Grow/Scale tier). Year 1 is 100% up to $100,000 generally, or 100% up to $250,000 for AI-first startups; Year 2 is 20% up to an additional $100,000. Credits cover Google models such as Gemini and Gemma; third-party models are billed directly and are not covered. Eligibility is selection-based: Pre-Seed/Seed within the last five years or Series A within the last 12 months, founded within five years, not yet received more than $5,000 in Google Cloud credits, and at Google Cloud's discretion. This is distinct from the $300 Free Trial listing.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: VC-funded AI-first startup (Pre-Seed/Seed in last 5 years or Series A in last 12 months), founded within 5 years, under $5,000 prior Google Cloud credits.
Apply at cloud.google.com/startup/ai (selection-based; acceptance is at Google Cloud's discretion).
If accepted, use program credits on Google Cloud services and Google models (Gemini/Gemma). Third-party models are not covered.
Do not confuse this with the separate $300 Google Cloud Free Trial.
